com.billy.glassmusic.name: Music
com.billy.glassmusic.subtitle: Offline music player
com.billy.glassmusic.localizedDescription: Play music stored on your iPhone offline. Browse songs, albums, and playlists; explore interactive clear CD cases with spinning artwork; and customize themes, album art, lyrics, and scrolling animations.

com.billy.echo.name: Echo
com.billy.echo.subtitle: Turn text into speech with your voice
com.billy.echo.localizedDescription: Turn typed text into speech using a short voice recording. Record or import a sample, save voices, and export clips as WAV files. Download a model before using it offline. Voice generation in this release still needs testing on a real iPhone.

com.billy.prism.name: Prism
com.billy.prism.subtitle: Generate and edit images with AI
com.billy.prism.localizedDescription: Create images from a text description, or add reference pictures and describe the edits you want. Download a model before using it offline, then save and export images from the gallery. Image generation in this release still needs testing on a real iPhone.

com.billy.facet.name: Facet
com.billy.facet.subtitle: Convert photos and videos to 3D
com.billy.facet.localizedDescription: Convert photos and videos into 3D on your iPhone. Export Apple Spatial, side-by-side, over-under and other stereo formats at the original pixel dimensions and video frame timing. Includes two offline depth models. HDR video is converted to SDR.

com.billy.veil.name: Veil
com.billy.veil.subtitle: Remove metadata from photos and videos
com.billy.veil.localizedDescription: Clean photos and videos on your iPhone without accounts, uploads or analytics. Import individual files, batches or folders; create separate copies; compare metadata reports and SHA-256 fingerprints; save or share the results. Supports JPEG, PNG and HEIC photos, and ordinary SDR MOV/MP4 videos up to 4K/60 fps. Photos export as SDR. Includes a small-batch photo Share extension where supported by your installation method. Originals are unchanged. Metadata removal does not hide visible content or prevent image matching. Physical iPhone testing is still required for this first release.

com.billy.lucid.name: Lucid
com.billy.lucid.subtitle: Offline video enhancement · Beta
com.billy.lucid.localizedDescription: FIRST BETA. Restore video detail at its original resolution or upscale 2x/4x with bundled Real-ESRGAN. Native pastel pink-purple SwiftUI and Liquid Glass controls, adjustable strength, a 2-second preview, original audio preservation, pause/cancel, thermal safeguards, and a private local export library. RIFE 30/60 FPS motion interpolation is implemented and bundled in the iPhone build, but its two GPU tests require physical-device testing and are explicitly not reported as passed. Simulator tests cover restoration, exports, audio timing, orientation, cancellation and error handling. No accounts, uploads, analytics or model downloads. Standard-color SDR input only; up to 4K output and 1080p input for motion. H.264 MOV exports; originals stay untouched. Physical iPhone performance, heat, LiveContainer compatibility and long-export reliability remain unverified.

com.billy.rift.name: Rift
com.billy.rift.subtitle: Private offline AI chat
com.billy.rift.localizedDescription: Private offline iPhone chat with downloaded uncensored community models or an imported GGUF. Version 1.8 adds local image and file attachments from the composer’s plus button. Qwen3.5 4B image understanding uses the matching publisher vision encoder, an optional verified 676 MB download. Text and text-based PDFs are read locally. The same uncensored weights are retained, with no added content filter or cloud moderation. Includes the left conversation drawer, quick model menu, morphing composer and living crimson background. No accounts, analytics, uploaded recordings or cloud inference. Larger models and images depend on device and host memory. Version 1.8.1 fixes composer responsiveness and keeps the conversation drawer transition full height. Version 1.8.2 fixes installed-voice startup, restores liquid composer transitions, and adds a short uncensored default personality. Version 1.9 adds offline Pocket TTS streaming, Apple speech fallback, and Personal Voice import, recording and saved voice cloning. Version 1.9.1 adds floating particle history that reassembles while browsing earlier messages. Version 1.9.2 makes history particles more animated and keeps the effect active while scrolling. Version 1.9.3 adds the Q6_K download option for Qwen3.5 4B Aggressive uncensored. Version 1.9.4 reduces repeated UI and persistence work while preserving existing features and appearance. Version 1.9.5 adds a centered voice orb with reactive particles and reversible chat scattering, while suspending chat rendering during voice mode. Version 1.9.6 fixes chat visibility by limiting the voice scatter shader to individual message surfaces during transitions. Version 1.9.7 reduces voice response waits and adds a darker maroon voice scene, inward listening motion, denser rear particles and occasional neural connections.

com.billy.velvet.name: Velvet
com.billy.velvet.subtitle: Camera, photos and local search
com.billy.velvet.localizedDescription: Capture photos and videos, browse albums and favorites, and search your library on iPhone. Version 0.3 improves continuous autofocus and lens transitions, moves Search into Photos, and adds a bottom glass Library/Albums selector with a floating camera button. Supported cameras have a RAW photo toggle and 100/120 fps video choices, including 4K120 HEVC where available. Rear video still prefers 4K60. Camera settings use exposure steps and a separate manual-controls page. Media and search data remain encrypted on device. No accounts, analytics or runtime model download. Requires iOS 27. RAW video is unavailable; physical camera performance and LiveContainer behavior still need device validation.

com.billy.moonwake.name: Moonwake
com.billy.moonwake.subtitle: A starlight pixel adventure
com.billy.moonwake.localizedDescription: Explore five moonlit realms as Aster, a white-haired wanderer with a glowing starlight sword. Awaken fifteen runes, free five guardians and restore the moonwells to reach the ending. Sword combos, evasive dash, Moonpulse magic, amber spirit Wisp and moss guardian companions, hidden caches, upgrades and local saves. Original animated pixel artwork and seventeen original audio assets, native SwiftUI Liquid Glass menus, touch controls, controller and keyboard support, left-handed controls, reduced effects and Story difficulty. Built in native Swift with SpriteKit. Entirely offline, with no accounts, ads, purchases, analytics or downloads. Landscape iPhone and iPad; requires iOS 26 or later. Physical-device performance and sideload-host behavior still require device playtesting.

com.billy.loop.name: Loop
com.billy.loop.subtitle: Offline video effects, GIFs and loops
com.billy.loop.localizedDescription: Edit videos privately on your iPhone with one-tap cinematic looks, tracked subjects, Keep/Remove brush repairs, layered effects, local portrait and hair treatments, depth-aware atmosphere, saved looks and .cube color imports. Find loop endpoints, blend seams, freeze a subject or its surroundings, and add motion echoes. Keep the existing crop tracking, privacy overlays, captions, full-video imports and local projects. Save GIF, APNG, H.264, HEVC, optional 10-bit HLG HDR, or transparent APNG/HEVC video. Native Liquid Glass controls keep advanced settings tucked away. Models ship with the app; no accounts, ads, watermark, uploads or runtime model downloads. Selection may use a disclosed native compatibility fallback. Tracking, cutouts and depth remain estimates; HDR is not Dolby Vision passthrough. Requires iOS 26. Physical-iPhone performance, thermals, long 4K exports and sideload-host behavior still need device validation.

com.billy.orbit.name: Orbit
com.billy.orbit.subtitle: Spatial videos, with a little more depth
com.billy.orbit.localizedDescription: Open original spatial videos from Photos or Files and watch them full screen with depth that responds to left/right and up/down phone tilt. Native stereo decoding and on-device Metal rendering, portrait and landscape playback, depth strength, recenter, touch look-around, fit/fill, scrubbing, mute, looping and a local video library. Ice-blue and violet Liquid Glass interface. No accounts, ads, analytics, media uploads or model downloads. Regular movies play in 2D. The effect is a limited motion-parallax reconstruction; stereo artifacts can occur and hidden surfaces cannot be recovered. Requires iOS 26 or later. Physical iPhone quality, thermals and sideload-host behavior still need device validation.
